title: Closed course concierge test
one_line: Before building any learning path, walk five people through one closed-course decision and one small real one by hand, and see whether they come back to close it.

bottom_line.label: What the funnel says
bottom_line.text: The read-only count found 271 receipts but only 6 distinct owners, 4 users who were sent a first debrief, 0 who opted in to more, and 3 outcomes. You have not gone to market, so this is not a market funnel and says nothing about demand in either direction. It is the founder-and-tests baseline, and it shows the loop is rarely closed even by the people closest to it.

bottom_line.label: The test
bottom_line.text: A first positioning test, not a demand verdict. Five people, two of whom owe you nothing. One closed-course case with a hidden outcome (immediate feedback), then one small reversible real decision with a written trigger, abort and rollback, then a check at day 7. No build, nothing published, nothing sent by me.

bottom_line.label: The kill line
bottom_line.text: Fewer than 2 of the people who volunteer a real decision come back and close it unprompted: drop the learning-path framing and keep the readiness packet as an internal tool.

decisions.question: Run the five-person concierge test?
decisions.recommended: Yes. You pick the five and send the invitations yourself; I draft the script and the log sheet only.
decisions.why: It costs hours, builds nothing and tests the one thing that matters: do people return to close.

decisions.question: Who counts as one of the five?
decisions.recommended: At least two who owe you nothing and have a decision of their own pending. The rest can be people you know.
decisions.why: Friends are polite. A polite yes is the agreement without dissent the Shavasana check flags.

decisions.question: Which closed-course case first?
decisions.recommended: Case file 001 (the six-week outage) at good.arcs.care/cases, after one check: the outcome must be hideable until the learner has logged a prediction.
decisions.why: Both case pages exist with evidence cards that reveal as fog clears. Neither is confirmed to ask for a prediction first.

decisions.question: Hold the fake-door page until at least three concierge cohorts are in?
decisions.recommended: Yes. A public page that collects emails needs your go and a privacy line first, and one cohort cannot settle positioning.
decisions.why: Publishing and collecting addresses are outward-facing and cannot be taken back.

human: Set the numbers in the signal table yourself before the first session. Do not change them after.
A person who says it was great but does not return at day 7 is a no. Count returns, not praise.
Ask at day 7 without a reminder from you. A reminder you send tests your nudge, not their demand.
agent: Send nothing. Draft only; Zach sends. No form, no page, no email collection from this proposal.
Log by participant code, never by name or address. Aggregate only in any file I write.
The signal thresholds are Zach's. The ones below are suggestions until he sets them.
Do not touch _STATE/job-search/ or any VICO file.

tables.title: Positioning arms, tested over time
tables.intro: You have not tested positioning systematically yet. Five people cannot rank framings; they can only tell you which words made someone act. So the same script runs in repeated small cohorts over several weeks, each cohort hearing one framing, and the results are read as a trend, never as a winner from one round.

controls.name: Hidden outcome stays hidden until the prediction is saved
controls.plain: The closed-course case must not reveal the outcome before a prediction and confidence are recorded.
controls.bad: A case page whose outcome is visible in the page text before any prediction field exists fails.
controls.good: A case where the outcome appears only after a prediction is logged passes.
controls.assay_ready: specified; the two existing case pages have not been checked against this

controls.name: Permit needs all six lines
controls.plain: A real decision is accepted into the test only if the six packet lines are present, each either filled or marked unconfirmed.
controls.bad: A packet with no trigger or no abort and rollback fails.
controls.good: A packet with all six lines passes, even if some say unconfirmed.

controls.name: Signal frozen before the first session
controls.plain: The pass and kill lines are written and dated before the first learner, then not changed.
controls.bad: Thresholds edited after a session has started fail.
controls.good: A dated file whose thresholds match the table passes.
controls.threshold: thresholds unchanged after first session date

controls.name: No identities in any file
controls.plain: Logs use participant codes only. Names and addresses stay outside the repo.
controls.bad: A log containing an email address or full name fails a grep.
controls.good: A log with codes P1 to P5 passes.

glossary.plain: A past decision whose outcome is already known, used so a learner gets feedback in minutes instead of weeks.
The permit is a first small real decision logged with its safeguards. The license is the first one closed with a calibration reading.
How far a person's stated confidence was from what actually happened.
A page offering something that does not exist yet, used to count interest. Held here until the concierge result is in.
